purpose: T2.2/T2.3 crop-scale internal validation and G2; not final heldout-test or external evaluation
cohort_rule: existing SHA256('val:20261102:record_id') ordered prefix32; source-held-out from train
caption: A high quality video.

mask.rule: SHA256([namespace,seed,record_id]) first8bytes big-endian modulo5 selects start
mask.neighbors: exactly the two original clean frames immediately before/after the span
mask.relationship_to_latent_A2: independent pixel evaluation mask; not a claim of support on exactly two VAE latents; latent-level A2 separately excludes latent0

condition_weights: all five types equal; never choose favorable types after scores

noise.generator: per-record/per-frame local CPU torch.Generator; no model/training/sampling seed in its derivation

drop_repeat.source: original clean LR frame immediately before the span; repeated independently into every selected frame

input_pixels: authoritative CPU float32 NPY arrays; clean LR uses unchanged float32 bicubic x4; only selected codec frames quantize to RGB24; unselected frames byte-identical to clean LR
metric_pixels: all restored outputs and HR targets use shared round(clamp(rgb,0,1)*255)/255 PNG-equivalent values; no MP4 metrics

metrics.corrupted_frame_primary: LPIPS AlexNet v0.1 mean over the8 selected original pixel-frame indices
metrics.fidelity: RGB PSNR/SSIM with no border shave; no unimplemented Y-channel alias
metrics.temporal_primary: existing TecoGAN tLP100 after full33-frame evaluation, restricted to original adjacent pairs touching at least one masked frame
metrics.temporal_rule: cutfr2 retains frames2..30, pairs(2,3)..(29,30); mask-touch has9 pairs, including2 boundary pairs; never delete/join frames
metrics.supplementary: all-frame quality, clean-neighbor quality, raw gaps, clean counterpart gaps, direct masked damage, all28-pair tLP100 and each degradation type

G2.aggregation: first mean sampling42/43 within clip; equal clips within each training seed/type; equal all5 types within each training seed; equal3 training seeds
G2.paired_excess_gap: corrupted harm gap minus same-checkpoint/sampling-seed clean counterpart harm gap
G2.seed_spread: sample SD(ddof1) across3 training-seed clean corresponding harm-gap means
G2.pass: both mean PSNR paired excess gap and mean LPIPS paired excess gap strictly exceed their respective clean-gap training-seed sample SD
G2.failure: report and stop; never change severity/mask/cohort in place or auto-search for a passing gate

heldout_policy: internal test211 and REDS4/YouHQ40 are reserved for final selected models under a separately frozen future protocol; no test/external pixels or scores used by these scripts
